newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemeni interior minister expresses optimism that his country's border conflict with Saudi Arabia would be settled within days or weeks.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines denies reports that a joint panel with the private sector had discussed the project of a domestic airline.
- Saudi Arabia's non-oil exports rose by 20 percent last year, finance minister says.
- Two ships of the royal Malaysian navy will visit Saudi from August 15 on a goodwill visit.
- Saudi Arabia beheads an Indian accused of smuggling drugs into the kingdom.
- King Fahd praises role of the trade sector in developing the kingdom's national economy.
- Sugar refinery plant in Jeddah offers new quantities of white sugar in the local market.
- Saudi is working to expand its power capacity, an official says.
- Saudi bankers propose the setting up of a special fund to finance local investment opportunities.
